text_en: I've brought backup!
Though I can see it wasn't needed...
General Brigard?!
I'm sorry to have worried you, General.
Let's go back to the city. You can tell me what's happened there.
What the...?
Is this a mirage?_300_ When my informants told me, I couldn't believe it. The great Brigard himself, in person!
Galath?!
The Lion of Dadelm?_300_ Here?
So that's why you didn't show up to the battlefield...
Bahahaha!_300_ My, my... How tragic! You died before you could even set off! What an end for the “unbeatable” Sword of Zarga.
The war... is over?! What happened?!
As far as I'm aware, up until those Valkyries appeared, no. But since you're here, I doubt it'll last much longer._100_ Unfortunately for me, I won't see the fall of Zarga with my own eyes...
That damned friend of yours gifted me an arrow in the back...
Riva! If you've hurt her...
Brigard... It's a war... If she isn't here yet, she will be soon.
Tsk...
The only thing that comforts me is that you fell first. So, what was it that happened to you?
Wait._100_ Those bodies..._500_ You aren't dead?!
Damn Brigard! Always trying to be the better one, even in the afterlife. Time to fix this problem.
Wait, Galath. There's no need for fighting. We're all searching for the same thing.
What I'm searching for is right in front of me. This moment was snatched away from me in battle, but don't think I plan on wasting a second chance.
Soldiers!_200_ Attack!
General Brigard!
Stay back, Adamont. We will handle this.
Enough!
So it's true what they say about the energy this world holds. Winning this battle means nothing, Brigard.
Fall back, soldiers!_100_ Best keep your eyes peeled, I won't abandon my prey so easily.
Dadelm's General is dead._100_ Perhaps all is not lost after all.
I don't know, Adamont. Zarga's forces have been practically halved. Even if Galath has fallen, winning this war will not be easy for them.
(Please, Riva... Survive)
We shall speak at the citadel and think of something.
Well done, soldier!
We're leaving.
Yes, General!
You heard the General!_100_  Fall behind and I'll kick you there myself. March!
